title: Vision Language Models are Confused Tourists

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on images of traditional cultural items (cuisine, attire, musical instruments) that have been perturbed with conflicting geographical cues (flags, landmarks) using image stacking or generative techniques, and measuring the accuracy drop and Model Distraction Likelihood.

Analyzing the distribution of incorrect model predictions to identify a 'Specific Country Fallback Bias,' where models systematically default to over-predicting certain high-resource countries (e.g., India, China, Japan) due to their over-representation in training data.
